verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a self-hostable vector database, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Qdrant Edge's 'no network required' and self-hosted deployment are adjacent deployment traits, not a documented opt-out control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
